name: Ursaring
description: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes. This lowers the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
